device_label: C-band MZM, 15 um plasmonic phase shifters
epitaxy_or_stack: SiN 800 x 800 nm2 in SiO2; BTO approx 200 nm thick, approx 100 nm above SiN (spacer not stated); vertical directional coupler 80 um; gold plates form plasmonic slot
modulation_format: 2PAM at 256 GBd; 4PAM at 170 GBd; 8PAM at 96 GBd
notes: Row granularity: one row per distinct device (MZM, IQ, racetrack); DC and RF Vpi and all data-rate points share the row. Vpi columns are per phase shifter (3.6 V DC, 6.4 V at 40 GHz); the push-pull MZ Vpi of 1.8 V at DC (paper headline) is in vpi_mzm_pushpull_dc_v. 6.4 V at 40 GHz is given in phase-shifter context, MZ-level RF Vpi not stated. 3 dB BW is referenced to 10 GHz (response drops several dB between 10 MHz and 10 GHz) and sits at the 110 GHz measurement limit; Fig. 2d normalization not stated. No on-chip IL reported: 20.3 dB is fiber-to-fiber incl. 2.8 dB per grating coupler and 3.5 dB per photonic-to-plasmonic converter (cutback); paper simulates ideal 8.1 dB fiber-to-fiber (not entered). prop_loss is the plasmonic section only (0.5 dB/um); BTO waveguide 4.5 dB/cm not entered. Fiber transmission over 400 m: 256 GBd 2PAM BER 3.11e-2, 4PAM 160 GBd BER 4.00e-2. Linear-EQ-only (21-tap FFE) reaches 196 GBd. Pockels coefficient about 180 pm/V at 40 GHz (paper extraction). Bias for Vpi not given as a value: BTO fully poled before the DC sweep; 2-3 V poling bias used in data runs. Not reported: Z0, n_RF, ng, RF loss, electrode thickness, ER, net rate.

device_label: C-band IQ modulator, 17.5 um plasmonic phase shifters
epitaxy_or_stack: SiN 800 x 800 nm2 in SiO2; BTO approx 200 nm thick, approx 100 nm above SiN (spacer not stated); vertical directional coupler 80 um; gold plates form plasmonic slot
notes: Vpi columns are per phase shifter (4 V DC); MZ push-pull Vpi 2 V in vpi_mzm_pushpull_dc_v. No RF Vpi reported. 3 dB BW 70 GHz is the paper statement (3 dB drop between 10 and 70 GHz; Fig. 3b caption also says cutoff around 80 GHz), referenced to 10 GHz; measurement upper limit for this device not stated. Fiber-to-fiber IL 23.9 dB at 1550 nm (22.5 dB at 1530 nm); no on-chip IL reported; paper projects approx 12 dB fiber-to-fiber (simulation, not entered). prop_loss is plasmonic section only (approx 0.7 dB/um, 100 nm slot). Higher DC Vpi than MZM attributed by paper to possible surface or dead layers. Linear EQ only: 192 GBd below SD-FEC; full DSP 160 GBd below KP4-FEC. Not reported: Z0, n_RF, ng, RF loss, ER, net rate, energy per bit, capacitance. Input power and drive amplitude in columns.

device_label: O-band racetrack, 5 um plasmonic phase shifter
epitaxy_or_stack: SiN 600 x 800 nm2 in SiO2; BTO approx 200 nm thick, approx 100 nm above SiN (spacer not stated); vertical directional coupler 40 um; gold plates form plasmonic slot
notes: Resonant device. Vpi 3 V DC derived by the paper from 0.3 nm/V tuning (FSR 1.79 nm) after poling; single phase shifter in the cavity. On-chip device loss (below 2 dB, from reference waveguides) and ER (above 6 dB, static, Fig. 4b) are bounds entered as numbers with lt/gt qualifiers; what the 2 dB includes is not stated. Fiber-to-fiber 9.4 dB at 1310-1315 nm. No 3 dB bandwidth number given; the electro-optic response is flat to the 70 GHz axis limit (Fig. 4d), and the paper says the resonant optical bandwidth is lower than that of the MZM. Max line rate 200 Gb/s is arithmetic from 2PAM (see derived). Linear EQ only: 176 GBd. Not reported: slot width, RF Vpi, VpiL, Z0, n_RF, ng, RF loss, capacitance, energy per bit.
